note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; only the soldier is described, the alate being recorded as unknown. The rostrum length of 0.70 mm is a value calculated in the original from the figure. Distribution records, synonymic citations and figure numbers are not included.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule pyriform, constricted behind the antennae, length with rostrum 1.28–1.59 mm; antennae 12–13-segmented, segment 3 2 times as long as segment 2; mandibles vestigial, each with a long spine-like process; pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior and posterior margins without notches.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish red to brownish red, rostrum slightly darker than the head capsule; antennae pale brown; pronotum and abdominal tergites yellowish brown. Posterior part of the head capsule with 1 pair of setae; apex of the rostrum with a few hairs; pronotum and abdominal tergites with scattered hairs, the last few tergites with long hairs, sternites with short and long hairs. Head capsule pyriform, constricted behind the antennae; length with rostrum 1.28–1.59 mm, length without rostrum 0.78–0.98 mm, maximum width 0.64–0.85 mm; in lateral view slightly concave behind the rostrum, with a weak elevation. Rostrum long and cylindrical, about 0.70 mm long. Antennae 12–13-segmented, segment 3 2 times as long as segment 2. Mandibles vestigial, each with a long spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior and posterior margins without notches or emarginations; 0.16–0.20 mm long, 0.37–0.46 mm wide.
